text:
alex: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — we sketched a handful of test/eval additions. Need explicit owners, timelines, and where to land them (repo/cron/console). I'll capture action items here.
maria: Agree. I'll take the prompt-set curation for the regression that caught the hallucination. Goal: prompt set + eval harness in repo redwood/evals by EOW. Assigning to @maria. :memo:
taylor: I'll own the KV eviction load test config. Plan: extend load-tests/kveviction.yaml, add steady-state and spike scenarios. ETA next Tue. I'll put a PR in and flag eng-sre for runbook hooks.
sara: I'll do the chaos drill design (partial node loss + kv eviction) — need a runbook and blast radius matrix. Can we target a tabletop drill in two weeks? Also will add the drill to the quarterly chaos calendar.
alex: Good. For ownership tracking, can we standardize issues using the label "postmortem-followup" and the template `remediation + test`? Example snippet for the issue body:

```
- Incident: <link>
- Owner: @
- Deliverable: prompt set / regression / load test / chaos drill
- Repo/location:
- ETA:
- Validation: eval name / perf threshold / gating alerts
```

maria: +1. I'll create the issue template and a GH project column "PM-followups" and start moving items there.
devops-bot: New issue template PR opened at https://github.com/redwood/evals/pull/124 :robot_face:
taylor: For automation — propose a scheduled run for the new regression suite: cron: `0 3 * * * /usr/local/bin/run-evals --suite=kv-eviction --report-to=evals-dashboard` That should exercise it daily off-peak. Thoughts?
sara: Daily sounds fine initially. We'll reduce to 3x/week after two weeks if stable. Need alert thresholds for regressions — propose fail on >3% accuracy delta or >15% latency regression.
alex: Add to Console: create route "postmortem-evals" with per-suite trend charts and an auto-ticket on regression failures (create if 3 consecutive failures). Can someone own dashboard work?
maria: I can wire the eval config to the console. ETA Thurs.
taylor: I'll add the load test job and the log hooks to ship perf metrics to the console.
sara: For chaos drill, I need an ops contact. @taylor you good to be on-call for the drill window?
taylor: Yep happy to handle ops on the drill day.
alex: Great. Final action list (I'll paste into the postmortem doc later):
- Prompt set curation + eval harness — owner: maria — ETA: EOW — repo: redwood/evals — issue labels: postmortem-followup, eval
- KV eviction load test + steady/spike scenarios — owner: taylor — ETA: next Tue — repo: redwood/load-tests — CI cron
- Chaos drill design + runbook + tabletop — owner: sara — ETA: 2 weeks — calendar: quarterly-chaos
- Issue template + GH project column + automation for tickets — owner: maria — ETA: Thurs
- Console dashboard & auto-ticketing — owner: maria/taylor — ETA: Thurs/next Tue
- Daily scheduled regression run (initial) — owner: taylor — cron: as above
maria: I'll add the items to the postmortem doc and ping for review.
sara: Also flagging recurring pattern: we've seen KV eviction incidents with ~3-week periodicity. Recommend adding a recurring regression that sweeps the last 3 weeks of traffic distribution in the eval harness.
alex: Good call. Add to backlog item: "recurrence-pattern tests" — to automate synthetic workloads mirroring 3-week periodic fluctuations.
taylor: I'll prototype the synthetic workload generator and attach sample configs to the load-tests repo.
maria: ping @eng-sre for validation once PRs land.
devops-bot: deploy bot: CI pipeline run for branch maria/postmortem-templates succeeded :white_check_mark:
alex: thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with owners/tags and close the loop. If anything slips, reassign in GH project.
